properties.name: Lake Tahoe Commons Beach
properties.note: Dogs prohibited on the sand, lawn, and picnic areas; leashed dogs may pass through on the paved trail at the upper edge.

properties.name: Lake Forest Beach Park
properties.note: County beach rules are explicit — no dogs on the beach or in the water.

properties.name: William Kent Beach
properties.note: One of six USFS designated swim beaches where pets are prohibited.

properties.name: Tahoe City Dog Park
properties.note: The designated off-leash spot in town — dawn to dusk, water and clean-up bags on site; closes for winter after the first snow. Location approximate.

properties.name: Tahoe City PUD Boat Ramp
properties.note: TCPUD's sanctioned dog water access — dogs allowed next to the boat ramp; Placer County leash law applies.

properties.name: Gate Keepers Cottage
properties.note: The one State Parks shoreline in town where leashed dogs are legal — the day-use area at the Truckee River outlet. Boundary approximate.

properties.name: 64-Acres Park
properties.note: Trailhead park and riverbank — leashed dogs welcome on the paved network and at the water's edge.

properties.name: Tahoe State Recreational Area
properties.note: Dogs are limited to the Gatekeepers day-use area; the campground and its beach are a no-dog zone.

properties.name: Burton Creek State Park
properties.note: State Parks baseline — dogs on paved roads only, max 6-foot leash, and ski trails closed to dogs Nov 1 – May 1.

properties.name: Olympic Valley Bike Trail
properties.note: TCPUD's paved network — dogs on a short leash, kept to the handler's side; shared with bikes.
